claims: The 98th Academy Awards were on March 15, 2026.
A tie occurred in the Best Live-Action Short Film category at the 98th Academy Awards.
The winners in the Best Live-Action Short Film category at the 98th Academy Awards were "The Singers" and "Two People Exchanging Saliva".
The tie marks the seventh official tie in Oscar history.
The tie is the first since 2013.
"Skyfall" and "Zero Dark Thirty" shared the Best Sound Editing award in 2013.
A video shows the moment the tie was announced at the 2026 Oscars.
